# oasdiff err-ignore — deliberate, reviewed breaking-change allowances (ADR 0003 Decision 7:
# reconcile drift by direction). Each entry below is the EXACT oasdiff singleline text of a
# spec-to-reality reconciliation that oasdiff classifies as breaking but that breaks no working
# client, because the prior spec never matched the server. oasdiff only suppresses a change when
# an ignore line contains that change's full operation+path AND message, so each entry is
# surgical — it cannot mask any other (or future) breaking change. Fail-closed: if the pinned
# oasdiff's wording changes on a version bump, the entry stops matching and the gate re-flags it.
# Entries are safe to prune once merged into the base branch (the corrected shape becomes the
# baseline and no longer diffs).
#
# createCollection (POST entity/{format}) request body corrected from object to array-of-object:
# the endpoint has always required a JSON array of {model, payload}; the prior object schema was
# stale documentation the server never honoured (a bare object is rejected with 400). Correcting
# the schema to the real shape is the reconciliation this PR performs (E4).
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /entity/{format} the request's body `type/format` changed from `object/json` to `array<object>` [request-body-type-changed].

# stats/audit/search slice (ADR 0003 Decision 7 — spec-to-reality reconciliation; prior spec never matched server):

# rejected — the handler unmarshals an object). ADR 0003 Decision 7.

# message slice — deleteMessages (DELETE /message) request body corrected from a
# single string/uuid to the real array<string> of ids; prior schema was prototype
# drift (the handler unmarshals []string). ADR 0003 Decision 7.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API DELETE /message the request's body `type/format` changed from `string/uuid` to `array<string/uuid>` [request-body-type-changed].
#
# getMessage/deleteMessage path param messageId: format uuid-v1 -> uuid (F5).
# uuid-v1 is a non-standard custom format the server never validated; oasdiff treats
# format narrowing→broadening as a type change (ERR), but widening the accepted set
# breaks no client. The fictional 400 "not a time-based UUID" was prototype drift —
# server performs no version check; any absent uuid -> 404. ADR 0003 Decision 7.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API DELETE /message/{messageId} for the `path` request parameter `messageId`, the `format` was changed from `uuid-v1` to `uuid` [request-parameter-type-changed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /message/{messageId} for the `path` request parameter `messageId`, the `format` was changed from `uuid-v1` to `uuid` [request-parameter-type-changed].
#
# getMessage (GET /message/{messageId}) — metaData simplified to a flat symmetric map:
# the values/indexedValues split and the injected typeReferences were cyoda-cloud indexing
# artifacts the cyoda-go contract does not carry; cyoda-cloud conforms. The required
# values/indexedValues properties disappear from the response schema because
# EdgeMessageMetaData is now an open flat map (additionalProperties:true, no named
# properties). No working client depended on the bucketed schema — it was prototype-era
# drift. ADR 0003 Decision 7.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /message/{messageId} removed the required property `metaData/indexedValues` from the response with the `200` status [response-required-property-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /message/{messageId} removed the required property `metaData/values` from the response with the `200` status [response-required-property-removed].

# are unrouted (404); no working client depends on the malformed shape. oasdiff
# previously treated the sibling $ref as per-object properties on an untyped array

# required properties appear "removed" — they were never real constraints.

# scheduled-transition Function (schedule.function) — delayMs de-required on TransitionScheduleDto.
# NOTE: unlike the reconciliation entries above, this is an INTENTIONAL, schema-version-gated
# feature evolution, not a spec-to-reality drift fix. A schedule now sources its firing time from
# EITHER `delayMs` OR `function` (mutually exclusive), so `delayMs` can no longer be required; the
# workflow-import contract bumped 1.2 -> 1.3 for this. An exported workflow that uses `function`
# legitimately has no `delayMs`. No pre-1.3 workflow lacks `delayMs`, so existing exports are
# unaffected; consumers of exported definitions must handle `delayMs` absence on 1.3+ schedules.
# This accepted breaking change is called out in CHANGELOG.md.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /model/{entityName}/{modelVersion}/workflow/export the response property `workflows/items/states/additionalProperties/transitions/items/schedule/delayMs` became optional for the status `200` [response-property-became-optional].

# direct search — limit floor (searchEntities): the `limit` query parameter was
# always type:string with an inert `maximum: 10000` (a numeric constraint on a
# string schema constrains nothing). Direct search is now bounded-or-fail: a
# matched set larger than `limit` fails instead of truncating, so `limit=0`
# (previously an unbounded synchronous search) and other non-positive values
# are no longer accepted. The added `pattern` enforces the real 1-10000 range
# on the string encoding — this is an INTENTIONAL, accepted breaking change,
# not spec-to-reality drift, called out in CHANGELOG.md.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /search/direct/{entityName}/{modelVersion} added the pattern `^([1-9][0-9]{0,3}|10000)$` to the `query` request parameter `limit` [request-parameter-pattern-added].

# function conditions removed from the search / async-search / grouped-stats request
# unions: a FUNCTION clause is a workflow/transition-criterion shape the engine dispatches
# to a compute member. Search has no dispatcher — the clause defeated pushdown translation
# and then died in the in-process kernel, so the server answered a request carrying one with
# a 500 (or, on async submit, a job that silently ended FAILED). The spec advertised a shape
# the server never served; it is now rejected at the boundary with 400 INVALID_CONDITION and
# the union corrected to match. No working client depended on it — there was no working
# client. FunctionConditionDto is unchanged and still reachable from the workflow/transition
# `criterion` unions, where it is valid. ADR 0003 Decision 7 (spec-to-reality reconciliation).
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /entity/stats/{entityName}/{modelVersion}/query removed `#/components/schemas/FunctionConditionDto` from the `condition` request property `oneOf` list [request-property-one-of-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /search/async/{entityName}/{modelVersion} removed `#/components/schemas/FunctionConditionDto` from the request body `oneOf` list [request-body-one-of-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /search/direct/{entityName}/{modelVersion} removed `#/components/schemas/FunctionConditionDto` from the request body `oneOf` list [request-body-one-of-removed].

# transaction-control params (#379 family) — fictional defaults removed from
# transactionTimeoutMillis (7 entity write ops + newMessage) and transactionSize
# (deleteEntities, deleteMessages). The server NEVER applied these defaults — the
# params were bound but unread until this change, so no client ever observed a
# 10000ms timeout or 1000-sized batches from omitting the param. Honoring the
# params is opt-in by settled version policy (absent ⇒ no timeout / single
# transaction, byte-identical to prior behavior); removing the advertised-but-
# inert defaults is spec-to-reality reconciliation (ADR 0003 Decision 7), the
# same class as v0.8.2's removal of the fictional search timeoutMillis. See
# docs/cloud-parity/transaction-control-params.md.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API DELETE /entity/{entityName}/{modelVersion} for the `query` request parameter `transactionSize`, default value `1000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /entity/{format} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PUT /entity/{format} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PATCH /entity/{format}/{entityId} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PUT /entity/{format}/{entityId} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PATCH /entity/{format}/{entityId}/{transition} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PUT /entity/{format}/{entityId}/{transition} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /entity/{format}/{entityName}/{modelVersion} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API DELETE /message for the `query` request parameter `transactionSize`, default value `1000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /message/new/{subject} for the `query` request parameter `transactionTimeoutMillis`, default value `10000.00` was removed [request-parameter-default-value-removed].

# M2M-only access with on-behalf-of identity — deliberate breaking removals (spec
# docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-01-624-m2m-only-access-design.md §9 and §12; CHANGELOG
# [Unreleased] ### Breaking). These are contract changes, not reconciliations: there are no
# production instances, and the release notes carry the migration. oasdiff matches an entry
# on its operation, path and message only — the file named after "error at" is not compared —
# so a removed path is written with the same api/openapi.yaml prefix as every other entry.
#
# Federated OIDC providers are removed: every /oauth/oidc/providers operation is gone.
# Trusted keys lose `audience` and their grace period: the invalidate request has no body.
# The token exchange accepts only subject_token_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /oauth/keys/trusted removed the required property `items/audience` from the response with the `200` status [response-required-property-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/keys/trusted removed the required property `audience` from the response with the `200` status [response-required-property-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/keys/trusted/{keyId}/invalidate removed the request body [request-body-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/keys/trusted/{keyId}/reactivate removed the required property `audience` from the response with the `200` status [response-required-property-removed].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API GET /oauth/oidc/providers api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/oidc/providers api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/oidc/providers/reload api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API DELETE /oauth/oidc/providers/{id} api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API PATCH /oauth/oidc/providers/{id} api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/oidc/providers/{id}/invalidate api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/oidc/providers/{id}/reactivate api path removed without deprecation [api-path-removed-without-deprecation].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/token removed the enum value `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token` of the request property `subject_token_type` [request-property-enum-value-removed].
#
# A key pair's invalidation grace period is capped at 3600 s, the longest token lifetime
# (was 366 days): no token outlives it, so a longer grace only kept a revoked key verifying.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/keys/keypair the `invalidateGracePeriodSec` request property's max was decreased to `3600.00` [request-property-max-decreased].
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/keys/keypair/{keyId}/invalidate the `gracePeriodSec` request property's max was decreased to `3600.00` [request-property-max-decreased].
#
# POST /oauth/token always required grant_type: a request without it answers
# 400 unsupported_grant_type. The document now says so; the wire is unchanged.
error at api/openapi.yaml, in API POST /oauth/token the request property `grant_type` became required [request-property-became-required].
